payload.description:
## Context

Combined tracker CI observed attributed_s 0.033 greater than total_s 0.032 in the unchanged landing timing contract. The current recorder rounds every stage separately before summing. Establish a deterministic rounding-boundary counterexample, then allocate reported stages from cumulative elapsed time. Keep the original assertion and all hooks enabled. Isolate this correction from unsettled-claim source.

## Scope

Only landing timing allocation, deterministic regression controls and its changelog fragment.
